help.title: Help
guide.title: How AmaniCare works
guide.intro: The family in the DRC sends the hospital bill, the family abroad pays it, and the money goes straight to the hospital. Every bill is checked first.
guide.payer.1.d: Invite your relative in the DRC with a link on WhatsApp, or accept the invitation they sent you.
guide.payer.2.d: At the hospital, your relative takes a photo of the bill. AmaniCare reads it and checks the prices.
guide.payer.3.d: The hospital confirms on WhatsApp that the patient and the amount are correct.
guide.payer.4.t: You pay, the hospital is paid
guide.payer.4.d: You check the bill and pay by card. The money goes straight to the hospital. Everyone gets a message.
guide.family.1.d: Invite them with a link on WhatsApp, or accept their invitation. Sign up with your phone number. It's free for you.
guide.family.2.d: At the hospital, tap “Send a new bill” and take a clear photo. Check the details, choose the hospital, and send.
guide.family.3.d: The hospital receives a WhatsApp message and confirms the bill. Nothing to do on your side.
guide.family.4.d: Your relative abroad pays, and the money goes directly to the hospital. You get a message: the patient can leave.
guide.clinic.1.d: When a family sends one of your bills, you get a WhatsApp message with the patient, the bill number and the amount.
guide.clinic.2.d: Tap “Confirmer” if the patient and amount are correct, “Rejeter” if not. No app needed.
guide.clinic.3.d: Once the family pays, the money is sent to your account and you get a WhatsApp message with the reference.
trust.1.d: AmaniCare never holds the money. Payments go through a licensed bank.
trust.2.d: Prices are compared with usual prices, and the hospital confirms before anyone pays.
trust.3.d: The photo of the bill, each line, and every step until the hospital is paid.
faq.title: Questions
faq.cost.a: Nothing for the family in the DRC. The person who pays adds a small service fee, always shown on the Pay button before paying.
faq.time.a: As long as it takes the hospital to confirm and the payer to pay. The hospital is paid right after the payment. Each step is announced by message.
faq.clinic.q: My hospital isn't in the list. What can I do?
faq.clinic.a: Only registered hospitals can be paid, so the money always reaches the right place. Send us the hospital's name, area and phone number: we'll contact them.
faq.held.q: Why is a bill held or rejected?
faq.held.a: A bill gets an extra check when something looks unusual: a price far above normal, the same bill sent twice, or a photo that is hard to read. If it's rejected, ask the hospital for a correct bill and send it again.
faq.failed.a: Nothing is paid to the hospital. The person abroad can try again from the bill.
faq.many.q: Can I pay for several relatives?
faq.many.a: Yes. Invite each relative. A relative can also be linked to several people abroad and choose who pays each bill.
faq.privacy.a: Only you, your linked relative, the hospital concerned and our checking team. Read our privacy policy for details.
faq.code.a: Check your number is in international format (+243… or +1…). Wait a minute, then tap “Send me a code” again.
